notes.title: Food Truck Empire - Join the Open Playtest!
notes.content:
To all speer-throwers in vicinity - there’s fresh food to be hunted! 🍔
We’re at PAX West and to celebrate it we’ve opened the playtests for everyone! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35532228/48b2234cfda745a36262859eea657712554bdc99.jpg

If you’re at PAX West yourself - don’t hesitate and come say hello!
We’re located within Expo Hall at Indie Games Polska stall!

PAX West is a great moment to celebrate gaming in its entirety and as a part of those celebrations we’ve opened our Playtest for Food Truck Empire - now with truck customization included!

It’s THE moment - you can request access to our Open Playtests directly on our FTE Steam Storepage! 

How to do it? It's easy! 
1. Navigate to Food Truck Empire Steam Storepage
2. Scroll down a bit until a green button with "Request access" becomes visible
3. Click on that button! 
4. Wait a short while to receive an access and enjoy your session of Food Truck Empire

⚠️ As we’re still working on our game we’d love to hear back from you and hear your feedback!
You’ll find dedicated in-game buttons that wil allow you to share your feedback with us but you can also reach out to us on Discord! 

🚚 However if you'd rather have a chance to simply watch what we're cooking inside our Food Trucks then instead you can decide to watch our Gameplay Stream today - simply tune in to Food Truck Empire store page to join! 

This will be a great opportunity to see how Food Truck Empire has evolved since the last demo and to check out how the truck customization looks! 🎆

Have fun everyone and stay wunderbar! ❤️ 

💜 Join our Official Discord! 💜

notes.title: Wishlist Food Truck Empire - the newest Lichthund game! 🐶⚡
notes.content:
Achtung, speer-throwers! 🔱
We want to thank you for your continuous support of Lichtspeer throughout the years - we have no words to describe our gratitude. Actually, we do - ⚡ über ! ⚡

On a more serious note - we are working on an entirely new game called Food Truck Empire and we would love for you to tag along on our development journey if possible ❤️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35532228/0c7cc47579fb4ab0a4ca005b189f4b7417ea2448.png


Food Truck Empire is not just about cooking - it's about building an empire! Conquer the streets one fully-customizable food truck at a time. From a small fry to a 5-star champion. Find your customers, fill their bellies and build your business. If you like cooking and tycoons - you’ll love this game! 🍔🚚

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35532228/09e9a6c69dabddbb1cae3ab009e77dd15e82adb3.gif

 If you would like to stay up to date on all things Food Truck Empire, Lichthund and space dogs - please be sure to join our official Discord to chat with fellow Lichtfriends. 
https://discord.gg/eCF3XntQxt

notes.title: Sun's shining and our games are on huge discounts. Yep, must be the Summer Sale!
notes.content:
It's that time of the year again, where Lord Gaben (long may He reign) blesses us with discounts and sales. 

To make it easier for everyone to find great games worth their hard-earned money, we're throwing our titles into the ring!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34046344/2db2e49c791d9f436cef4e8d389847bb0b87b90d.png


 Want to tease your brain and solve some puzzles? MouseCraft is for you!
 Feel like doing some wacky construction in space with your friends? Bonkies is perfect!
 Your funny bone requires tickling? Once Upon a Jester will do just that!
 Want to shoot spears made of pure light at weird creatures? Lichtspeer's got your back!


See? There's something for everyone!

And while you're here, you can also check out our upcoming titles:

Techno Banter - an adventure game about being a bouncer guarding the entrance to a techno club. If you think you've got wits and humour to chase the unwanted guests away, test your mettle here!

The Gap - a serious, narrative story about a man fighting to save his own sanity and his family, while delving ever deeper into his past.

If those games pique your interest, it would mean a lot to us if you wishlisted!

Have a great Summer Sale, and may Lord Gaben have mercy on our wallets.

notes.title: Now available with thunderous drop-in drop-out co-op mode!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow spear-throwers!

A new version of Lichtspeer has been summoned - the Double Speer Edition is now available on Steam!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=522LpnIMumk

What's new?
Thanks to the new co-op mode, you can now explore the ancient germanic future with your friend - a space-dog! It's a drop-in drop-out mode, so feel free to complete the whole campaign as a duo or just have a go for a few minutes to kill some Wurst Zombies and leave your friend to play and die alone.

I bought the original Lichtspeer - will I get the Double Speer Edition for free?
Yes. If for some reason this didn't happen automatically, please let us know in the comments or contact us on publishing@crunchingkoalas.com.

What about the old version of Lichtspeer?
The old version of Lichtspeer has been discontinued - you can still play it if you own it, but you won't be able to buy it anymore.
